title: Selecting the Method Signature
goal: Return a string view from a struct method without copying the data.
hints: Check whether the caller needs an owned String or a borrow.
Elision connects &self to the returned reference automatically.
explanation: Lifetime elision rule three automatically ties the return reference `&str` to `&self`, which carries `'a`. Candidate 1 returns a view `&str` directly from `self.title` without any allocations or clones. Candidate 2 allocates a local `String` and attempts to return a reference to it, which fails to compile because the `String` is dropped at the end of the method. Candidate 3 introduces an unconstrained lifetime parameter `'b` that is not tied to `&self` or `'a`, leading to a compile error.
